# Antigravity Pet

> Antigravity Pet is a free, open-source pixel desktop pet for Google Antigravity on Windows and macOS. It sits on your desktop and shows what your agent is doing, live — no window switching, no runtime to install.

## Install

- [Latest release](https://github.com/Wlaeg/antigravity-pet/releases/latest)
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Wlaeg/antigravity-pet)
- [Landing page](https://wlaeg.github.io/antigravity-pet/)

Install with: `agy plugin install https://github.com/Wlaeg/antigravity-pet`

## Features

- Live tool-call bubbles: the bubble above the pet shows the agent's current tool call.
- Double-click the pet to dispatch a task; approve or deny tool calls right in the bubble.
- Background tasks get their own calm moon state with a task switcher.
- Community workshop: browse and install community pet packs in Settings; one static PNG is enough to make your own pet.
- Surprise Mode: 200 tasks (or starring the repo) unlocks 150 locally generated pixel accessories across 4 gear slots.
- 8 built-in mascots: cyber-fox, astro-bot, shadow-cat, byte-ghost, shiba-dog, pixel-dragon, android-bugdroid, flutter-dash.
- Edge peeking, fullscreen auto-hide, typing sync, boredom and naps. Zero telemetry.
